# View Definitions

## Views

Each view is generated by selecting card types (and optional subtypes). A view can also be filtered to a specific subgraph by selecting one or two **root cards** (for example, selecting a single `State Machine` card to render one state machine rather than all state machines).

| View | Description | Root cards (selectable) | Included card types | Supporting card types | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Abuse/Misuse Case View | Captures adversarial user stories that complement use cases for security and safety. | Actor; Story (Abuse); Threat | Story, Threat | Actor, Risk, Control, Requirement, Constraint, Feature, Note | Abuse/misuse cases are stories linked to threats and mitigations. |
| Build and Release Pipeline View (DevSecOps) | Shows CI/CD stages, gates, artifact promotion, signing, SBOM, and approvals. | Process; Deployment | Process, Activity | Control, Constraint, Event, Deployment, Artifact, Note | Pipeline is an analogy for a process; stages are activities; gates are controls/constraints. |
| Capability Map and Heatmap | Lists business/technical capabilities with maturity, pain, investment priority, and ownership. | Capability | Capability | Driver, Requirement, Actor, System, Boundary, Note | Heatmap metrics are typically stored in `Capability.attributes`. |
| Change Impact View | Focused neighborhood view answering “if this changes, what breaks?” | Focus card (any type) | All card types | Boundary, Note | Render inbound and outbound links for the selected focus card (configurable traversal depth). |
| Class View | Shows key classes and relationships (inheritance/aggregation/composition/dependencies) for implementation-level design. | Class | Class, Interface | Component, Application, System, Boundary, Note | Class details (properties/methods) live in `Class.attributes`. |
| Communication View | Shows interactions between participants emphasizing connectivity rather than time. | Component; Interface | Component, Interface, Artifact | Actor, System, Boundary, Note | Same elements as sequence; emphasize connectivity over ordering. |
| Component View | Shows components, responsibilities, and how they interact via interfaces. | System; Component | System, Application, Component, Interface | Boundary, Note, Data Store, Artifact | Use boundaries to express subsystems and packages. |
| Composite Structure View | Shows internal structure of a component/system and how parts collaborate. | Component | Component, Interface | System, Application, Data Store, Boundary, Note | Composite structure is a natural effect of nested components (`contains`/`comprises`). |
| Configuration and Secrets View | Shows sources of truth, rotation, injection points, and access policies. | Asset (Secret); Component | Asset, Control | Component, Interface, Data Store, Constraint, Note, Artifact | Secrets are assets; access and rotation are expressed with controls/constraints. |
| Conformance Report View | Automated checks for invariants, standards compliance, schema validation, and broken links. | Constraint; Requirement | Test, Constraint | Requirement, Artifact, Note | Conformance is represented as tests that validate constraints/requirements. |
| Constraints and Quality Attributes (NFR) View | Captures measurable NFRs (performance, reliability, scalability, observability, portability) and acceptance criteria. | Constraint; Requirement | Requirement, Constraint, Test | Risk, Control, Feature, Capability, Note | NFRs are constraints/requirements; tests validate them. |
| Context View (C4-Style / System Context) | Shows external actors/systems, trust boundaries, and high-level data exchanges. | System | System, Application, Actor, Interface | Data Store, Deployment, Node, Boundary, Note | Trust boundaries are modeled as `Boundary` (and/or constraints applied to boundaries). |
| Control Coverage View | Maps controls to assets, data classes, interfaces, and threats. | Control; Asset | Control, Asset | Data Store, Interface, Threat, Risk, Requirement, Feature, Note | Coverage is computed by following links from controls to scoped elements. |
| Cost Model / FinOps View | Shows cost drivers, unit economics, forecasts, and optimization opportunities. | Mission; System | All card types | Note, Constraint, Deployment, Node, Data Store, Asset | Cost is an attribute on any card; roll-ups are computed by reverse traversal toward `Mission`. |
| Data Model View | Shows data stores, key entities, relationships, and constraints (schema/domain data structures). | Data Store; Artifact (Data Entity) | Data Store, Artifact, Constraint | Interface, Component, Asset, Boundary, Note | Entities/elements are `Artifact` subtypes with `attributes.fields`; schema rules are `Constraint (Schema)`. |
| Decision Log View | Captures architectural decisions (ADRs): options, rationale, trade-offs, and consequences. | ADR | ADR | Constraint, Requirement, Note | ADRs are first-class cards for clarity and discoverability. |
| Deployment View | Shows deployments, nodes, and runtime hosting relationships (where things run). | Deployment; Node | Deployment, Node, Node Instance | System, Application, Component, Data Store, Interface, Boundary, Note | Root by deployment to isolate a specific environment. |
| Domain and Bounded Context View (DDD) | Shows bounded contexts, domain ownership, shared kernels, and integration patterns. | Boundary (Context); System | Boundary, System, Data Store | Application, Component, Asset, Actor, Interface, Note | Use `Boundary (Context)` for bounded contexts. |
| Environment View | Shows dev/test/stage/prod differences, feature flags, config strategy, and data handling per environment. | Deployment | Deployment, Node, Node Instance | Application, Component, Data Store, Control, Constraint, Note | Root by deployment/environment. |
| Everything View | Full-model overview showing every card and link in a single render. Direct paths from Mission are solid, alternate paths are dashed. | Mission | All card types | None | Use for end-to-end validation and holistic impact analysis. |
| Executive Summary View | One-page overview of mission, outcomes, scope, cost/risk headlines, top dependencies, and timeline. | Mission | Mission, Driver, Requirement, Capability, System | Application, Risk, Threat, Control, Constraint, Boundary, Note | Cost can be `attributes.cost` on any card; roll-ups are computed toward `Mission`. |
| Fitness Function View | Continuously evaluated measurable constraints (latency, coupling thresholds, security checks). | Test; Constraint | Test, Constraint | Requirement, Control, Note | Fitness functions are tests run continuously against constraints/requirements. |
| Initiative/Epic Portfolio View | Shows initiatives mapped to drivers, capabilities, requirements, and planned releases. | Artifact (Initiative/Epic); Driver | Artifact, Driver, Capability, Requirement, Feature | Boundary, Note | Optional: initiatives/epics are typically managed in a tracking system; model them as referenced artifacts if needed. |
| Lifecycle/State View for Assets | Tracks asset lifecycle (planned → active → deprecated → retired) with dates and replacement targets. | State Machine; Asset | State Machine, State, Event, Condition | Asset, Control, Constraint, Note | Lifecycle is another name for a state machine rooted on an asset lifecycle. |
| Object View | Shows a snapshot of instances and relationships at a point in time (useful for scenarios/examples). | Artifact (Object Snapshot) | Artifact, Class | Boundary, Note | Object snapshots are best modeled as `Artifact (Object Snapshot)` with example instance data in `attributes`. |
| Observability View | Shows logs/metrics/traces, dashboards, alerts, SLOs, error budgets, and ownership. | Artifact (Metric); Requirement | Artifact, Condition, Requirement, Test | Control, Component, Interface, Process, Activity, Note | Metrics are artifacts; conditions/requirements/tests define measurable parameters and acceptance criteria. |
| Operational Dependency View | Shows third-party services, quotas/limits, maintenance windows, and contractual constraints. | Actor; System | Actor, System | Interface, Constraint, Risk, Threat, Note, Boundary | Third parties are modeled as actors and/or external systems. |
| Package View | Shows packaging/module boundaries and dependencies (crate/module/layer boundaries). | Boundary (Package) | Boundary, Component | System, Application, Interface, Note | Packages are logical boundaries: use `Boundary (Package)` to group the contents. |
| Policy and Standards Compliance View | Shows which standards apply where, plus exceptions and compensating controls. | Constraint; Control | Constraint, Control | Requirement, Risk, Threat, Asset, Interface, Note | Laws, rules, regulations, and policies are constraint subtypes applied to scope. |
| Privacy and Data Classification View | Shows data classes, retention, residency, and (if relevant) lawful basis/DPIA triggers. | Asset; Data Store | Asset, Data Store, Constraint | Control, Requirement, Risk, Actor, Note | Data classes are attributes on assets; policies are constraints. |
| Process (Activity) View | Shows workflows/steps and branching logic for a process. | Process | Process, Activity, Event, Condition | Actor, Control, Constraint, Boundary, Note | Value stream views are a specialization of this view. |
| RACI / Ownership Matrix View | Shows accountable owners for capabilities, systems, data domains, services, and controls. | Actor; System | Actor | Capability, System, Application, Component, Data Store, Control, Note | Actor maps to Role; express RACI via explicit relationships such as `owns`, `oversees`, `facilitates`. |
| Reference Architecture / Patterns Library View | Catalog of approved patterns and anti-patterns and when-to-use guidance linked to model elements. | Note (Pattern) | Note | Feature, Capability, Component, Interface, Constraint, Artifact | Patterns are references and belong in notes, optionally linked to supporting artifacts. |
| Requirements View | Shows how drivers, requirements, constraints, capabilities, features, stories, and tests connect (traceability-focused). | Requirement; Driver | Mission, Driver, Requirement, Constraint, Capability, Feature, Story, Test | Boundary, Note | Rooting on a single requirement is the default way to slice traceability. |
| Resilience View | Shows availability targets, redundancy/failover, and RTO/RPO and DR topology. | Constraint (SLO/SLA); Deployment | Constraint, Deployment, Node, Data Store | System, Application, Component, Control, Risk, Note | SLO/SLA targets are constraint subtypes with measurable attributes. |
| Risk Register View (Architecture-Linked) | Lists risks with likelihood/impact, owners, mitigations, residual risk, and acceptance. | Risk | Risk | Threat, Control, Asset, Actor, Requirement, Feature, Note | Link risks to what they impact and what mitigates them. |
| Roadmap View | Time-phased plan of releases, milestones, decision points, and dependency critical path. | Artifact (Roadmap); Event | Artifact, Event | Feature, Requirement, Driver, Note | Optional: time planning is not required for the architecture model; represent a roadmap as a referenced artifact (and optionally dated events). |
| Runbook / Playbook Set View | Incident response, on-call procedures, standard remediations, and escalation paths. | Process; Actor | Process, Activity | Event, Actor, Control, Constraint, Note, Artifact | Runbooks are processes; a runbook document can optionally be an artifact. |
| Security Architecture View | Shows identity, authorization, secrets/key management, segmentation, and policy enforcement points. | System; Control | Control, Constraint, Interface, System | Application, Component, Asset, Data Store, Threat, Risk, Deployment, Node, Boundary, Note | Secrets are `Asset` subtypes; identity/authz is represented via controls, constraints, and interfaces. |
| Sequence View | Shows time-ordered interactions between participants (message-level behavior). | Process; Activity | Component, Interface, Artifact, Activity, Event | Actor, System, Boundary, Note | Messages can be modeled as `Artifact (Message)` payloads sent by components and calling interfaces (or as `Event`/`Activity` nodes), linked via `to_call`/`uses`. |
| State Machine View | Shows states and transitions for a lifecycle (accounts, assets, deployments, etc.). | State Machine | State Machine, State, Event, Condition | Activity, Control, Constraint, Boundary, Note | Lifecycle views are state machine views rooted on a lifecycle state machine. |
| Test Strategy and Traceability View | Maps tests to requirements, risks, controls, and interfaces. | Requirement; Test | Test, Requirement | Control, Risk, Threat, Interface, Feature, Capability, Note | Root by requirement (what is tested) or by test (what validates what). |
| Threat Model View | Threat-focused process view: threat actors, threats, attack steps, and mitigations mapped to controls/constraints. | Threat; Actor | Process, Activity, Threat, Actor | Risk, Control, Constraint, Event, Interface, Boundary, Note | Threat modeling is a process view centered on threats and threat actors. |
| Timing View | Shows time constraints, timing windows, and temporal behavior where ordering and duration matter. | Event; Condition | Event, Condition | Activity, State, Constraint, Boundary, Note | Timers are combinations of tick events (e.g., `Event`) and expiry conditions (e.g., `Condition`). |
| Use Case View | Shows user goals and system interactions at a behavioral level. | Story; Actor | Actor, Story, Capability, Feature | Process, Activity, Event, Condition, Control, Constraint, Boundary, Note | Rooting on a story produces a concrete “one use case” slice. |
| Value Stream View | Shows end-to-end flows where value is created and where friction/hand-offs occur. | Process | Process, Activity, Event, Condition | Actor, Capability, Constraint, Control, Boundary, Note | Value streams are abstract processes (a specialized Process View). |
